name: CocoaMachine
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms. A small painted wooden hot cocoa booth like a toy-workshop kiosk: box-shaped wooden body with corner posts, a gable roof with puffy snow trim, a front window showing a big mug with steam, a sign board above the window, a dispenser slot with a cup tray, round bulbs along the eaves and a mug-shaped sign on the roof ridge. Single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Honey-coloured wood body with dark brown corner posts, red roof with white snow trim, big green mug with red and white candy-cane stripes and white steam, red sign board, silver dispenser with a cup tray, multicoloured glowing bulbs, glowing golden mug sign on the roof. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: Window faces +Z in Meshy; yaw 180 to face -Z. About the stand-in's 7 studs tall; Run stands it on the street by its bounding box.
